enrichment.headline: Adds $4,534,596 and 3 more years to Garfield Elementary's architect contract
enrichment.summary: The Board amends the district's agreement with Quattrocchi Kwok Architects for design and construction services to finish the modernization phases at Garfield Elementary School. The amendment adds $4,534,596.00, raising the not-to-exceed amount from $573,499.00 to $5,108,095.00, and extends the term to December 31, 2027. It is paid from the Measure Y building fund.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.sourceIssue: The text describes the extension as an additional 365 calendar days, but the stated dates (end of term moving from December 31, 2024 to December 31, 2027) span about three years.

enrichment.headline: Buys $40,820.14 in fire alarm parts from Johnson Controls for Roosevelt Middle portables
enrichment.summary: The district buys fire alarm materials and spare parts for thirteen temporary classroom portables and one administrative portable from Johnson Controls Fire Protection. The portables are part of the Roosevelt Middle School Interim Housing Phase II Project. Delivery is due between January 9, 2025 and March 30, 2025.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
